annotations.title: Verify a company in official registers (paid)

description: Company verification (KYB) from official registers: GLEIF worldwide (incl. Dutch LEI holders with KvK number), UK (Companies House), France (SIRENE), Norway, Finland, Czechia, Slovakia, and Poland by NIP (VAT whitelist, incl. bank accounts). Search by name or registry id: legal name, active or dissolved, registry id, legal form, address, founding date. For B2B onboarding, invoicing and supplier checks. Costs 0.008 USDC via x402, or 4 credits of a Factline API key.

country.description: ISO country, e.g. GB, FR, NO, NL

id.description: LEI, SIREN, Norwegian organisation number or UK company number
